MODULE_NOTES: Measures the Ordaen framework in game against hand-written code. For development: /ordaen bench round runs it.
CMD_ROUND: a bench round: every scenario, measured
CMD_CHECK: the round's checks only, with a few calls per series (about a minute)
CMD_VARIANTS: a round with the framework's naive and item-read variants too
CMD_PROBES: what WoW's own calls cost, for the drawing backend
CMD_WINDOW: show or hide the library's Window with a few settings controls, to compare with the design
